_comment: REAL AdMob ids (Zen Mahjong Journey app in the AdMob account). Used only by release builds on phones (AdsManager.release_ids). Debug builds, tests and the desktop always use the test ids in data/ads.json. Never put these ids in tests, and never tap ads served with them. The app_id must match [Release] app_id in addons/AdmobPlugin/android_export.cfg.
